text:
sara: Heads-up — cross-team status: Optimize toolkit final mile. Quant recs PR #482 is ready; need owners for canary rollout and a short QA window. Who can take deployment? cc eng-runtime, eng-ml
mike: I can own the canary rollout for this sprint (2 weeks). Need runtime sign-off on kernel flags and a smoke test plan. Ping @kevin for runtime review. :thumbsup:
anita: On it, reviewing PR now. Quick note — saw a perf blip on long sequences in local runs, adding a regression test to CI.
kevin: I'll take runtime sign-off; will check kernel flags and sequence perf by EOD. Which model family are we shipping with this config? llama2-70b or redwood-compat? 
olga: Quant recs summary I posted earlier stands but suggest toggling `batch_size` depending on SLOs. For low-latency: batch_size: 4; throughput mode: batch_size: 16. Also recommend KV cache TTL=60s for common prefixes.
anita: Adding CI perf test now. Patch:
```
# test_perf_long_seq.yml
- name: perf_long_sequence
  seq_len: 4096
  samples: 20
  assert: latency_p50 < 800ms
```
qa-bot: REGRESSION ALERT: staging run 2025-08-14T14:22Z — p50 latency +12% on seq_len >= 2048 for redwood-compat-quant. Linked run: https://ci.internal/runs/5892
mike: noted. I'll hold canary until QA gives green on staging. can we add a short A/B shadowing window to confirm? @anita
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by request: 2025-08-15T18:00:00Z — will deploy to 5% traffic, auto-rollback on error-rate>1% or latency_p95>2s
sara: Action items: 1) Mike = canary owner; 2) Kevin = runtime sign-off; 3) Anita = CI perf test + quick shadow test; 4) Olga = finalize quant knob defaults and write short runbook snippet. I'll open a checklist ticket and tag owners. Please update by EOD.
mike: CR ping to @anita on one comment in PR #482 re: batch heuristics — can you reply? 
anita: Reply posted, added a small fix to perf test threshold. Will re-run staging tonight and post results.
kevin: FYI — if perf regression persists, will try alternate kernel selection (intel-avx2 fallback) and report.
olga: I'll draft runbook section and include a simple tuning table + examples. Sharing a snippet here:
```
# tuning quickref
- low_latency: batch_size=4, quant=8bit, kv_ttl=30
- balanced: batch_size=8, quant=4bit, kv_ttl=60
- throughput: batch_size=16, quant=4bit, kv_ttl=120
```
sara: Great — thanks everyone. If staging clears, we target canary Tue 18:00 UTC. If any blocker shows, escalate here and I’ll coordinate rollback + incident hotline. :raised_hands:
